groups.saying_opens: إن المؤمن إذا مات لم يكن ميتا

notes: two sayings: the Imam's answer on death (saying 1, no transmitter, so a single link as in rule 10), and the report from al-Sadiq through the compiler's father, grandfather and great-grandfather (saying 2)
«يعني المؤمن من الكافر» is a gloss by the speaker and is left out
